name_clean.description: Jaro-Winkler at six similarity thresholds plus exact. Six thresholds give finer probability bucketing than two.

name_core.description: Exact match on the name with trailing legal-entity tokens stripped (see legal_entity_tokens.json).

name_tokens_sorted.description: Exact match on the sorted unique tokens of name_clean. Catches pairs whose words are the same but in a different order (A J TULLOCH vs TULLOCH A J).

postcode.description: Exact match on the cleaned postcode. Most donations carry no postcode, so agreement is strong evidence and disagreement is weak.

_threshold_notes: Provisional. threshold_candidate=0.05 is the floor scoring predicts down to; threshold_review=0.50 is the line below which pairs are not surfaced for review; threshold_high=0.92 auto-accepts. All three will be tuned against the 4,284 existing merge groups once matching lands.
